rows.text: Stop... I don't need the answer, I don't care for it. It's just something random I say to begin a conversation.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: We've added something — a new expansion module — into the Simulated Universe again recently.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But Stephen sees this as a major project and insists on creating a separate branch for it called Simulated Universe: Swarm Disaster.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: He thinks he's playing a video game.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Confused? Go through it yourself, and you'll get it.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: There's too much redundant data in the Simulated Universe. You went so far, yet you've only met the Aeons a couple of times. You worked so hard but didn't even get many chances to speak with them!
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: So, I plan to lock the cosmic time within a specific historical segment, narrowing down the scope to study a particular Aeon more effectively. However, I'm not sure which Amber Era to throw you into...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Ruan Mei has her own idea. She's made up her mind to anchor the cosmic time to the period before the fall of Tayzzyronth the Imperator Insectorum.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Anyway, please go ahead and take a look.
rows.speaker: Herta
